In detail

Favoriten is consistently identified in press coverage as Vienna's highest-crime district by volume: an oe24.at analysis of 2024 police data (April 2025) recorded 26,218 offenses there, more than any other district and well over the 15,114 in second-placed Floridsdorf. Reporting focuses heavily on two adjoining squares, Reumannplatz and Keplerplatz, where a police 'Schutzzone' (protection zone allowing preventive removal of suspected drug offenders) has been in force since October 2022 and remains actively enforced, with a drug-deal arrest there reported as recently as April 2026. Falter (April 2024) and vienna.at (March 2024) documented a spate of knife attacks and stabbings around Reumannplatz, including a soldier stabbed while intervening in a dispute, plus open drug dealing and group tensions a local vendor described as escalating easily into violence; a further Falter report (August 2025) revisited Keplerplatz as an ongoing drug-dealing flashpoint. Away from this specific corridor, the wider district (residential streets, the Favoritenstraße shopping strip) is not singled out in press coverage for particular danger, so daytime risk district-wide reflects the general elevated crime-volume backdrop rather than a specific threat; after dark, the Reumannplatz/Keplerplatz corridor specifically carries a well-documented, repeated pattern of drug dealing and occasional knife violence. Sources checked: oe24.at, 15 Apr 2025 – "Das sind die gefährlichsten Bezirke Wiens – Favoriten schlägt alle"; Falter, 5 Apr 2024 – "Der Reumannplatz ist zum Unort geworden"; vienna.at, 24 Mar 2024 – "Messerattacken, Drogen: Nächtlicher Lokalaugenschein am Wiener Reumannplatz"; meinbezirk.at, 5 Apr 2026 – "Käufer und Verkäufer geschnappt: Drogen-Deal am Reumannplatz von Polizei beobachtet"; vienna.at, 9 Nov 2022 – "Drogenszene: Schutzzone am Wiener Keplerplatz ab Samstag"; Falter, 5 Aug 2025 – "Brennpunkt Wien: Keplerplatz, Drogen, Migration, Polizei, FPÖ".
